# BloomBoard

> BloomBoard is a calm productivity app for individuals and small teams: tasks, boards, calendar, notes, team chat, voice and video calls, a live virtual office, and an AI assistant (Bloom AI) that plans your day. Mac and Windows apps and a web app.

## Plans
- Free: for individuals, no time limit, no card needed. Tasks, boards, calendar, notes and reminders.
- Bloom: from $6 per month, billed yearly. Adds Bloom AI and sync across your devices.
- Team: from $8 per person per month, billed yearly. Adds team chat, calls with screen sharing, the live office, shared boards, handovers, Workload Health and a daily team recap.

## What makes it different
- Live team office: see who is free, in a room, in focus or on leave; walk into rooms without links; knock first; lounge and all-hands rooms.
- Plan My Day: builds a realistic day around your meetings, with focus time, breaks and lunch, from tasks you already have, including unfinished work from yesterday.
- Email built in: Gmail and Outlook inbox, turn an email into a task, AI replies.
- Handover: hand your work to a teammate before a vacation.
- Privacy: no ads, no tracking, row-level security on every table. AI requests go to Anthropic's Claude API, which does not train on API data.
- Import: Trello boards (connect Trello or a JSON export).
